DECLARE @LastBatchID INT = ?;
DECLARE @RecordSource varchar(50) = ?;
DECLARE @Batchsize Int = 5000000;
DECLARE @CountryCode Int = 0;

IF @RecordSource = 'InterBranchAU'  SET @CountryCode = 1;
IF @RecordSource = 'InterBranchNZ'  SET @CountryCode = 6;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

SELECT  TOP (@Batchsize)
@CountryCode as 'CountryCode',
CASE @CountryCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Australia' WHEN 6 THEN 'New Zealand' END AS [Country],
d.[LabelNo],
d.[Franchise] as 'InvoiceFromRF',
i.[PickupRFCode] as 'InvoiceToRF',
d.[BatchId],
(CASE WHEN d.[Franchise] = i.PickupRFCode THEN 'Internal' ELSE 'Invoiced' END) as Category,
i.[Date],
d.[InvoiceNumber],
d.ProductId ,
convert(date,d.[CourierDate]) as 'DeliveryDate',
d.[CourierTime] as 'DeliveryTime',
convert(decimal(10,2),v.[DeliveryCostPerProduct]) as 'Price'

FROM [Fastway].[dbo].invbtch b WITH (NOLOCK)

INNER JOIN [invhead] i WITH (NOLOCK) on  b.BatchId = i.InvoiceBatchID and b.CountryCode = i.Country 
INNER JOIN  [Fastway].[dbo].[labels] d WITH (NOLOCK) ON ISNULL(d.BatchID,0) = b.BatchID and d.InvoiceNumber = i.InvoiceNumber and d.CountryCode = b.countryCode and d.InvoiceFranchiseAccountNumber = i.DeliveryFranchisee
LEFT JOIN prods p WITH (NOLOCK) on d.ProductId = p.ProductId and d.CountryCode = p.CountryCode
LEFT JOIN invdet v WITH (NOLOCK) on d.InvoiceNumber = v.InvoiceNumber and i.DeliveryFranchisee = v.DeliveryFranchisee and i.Country = v.CountryCode and p.LabelPrefix = v.Prefix

WHERE b.CountryCode = @CountryCode  and d.PickupDelivery = 'D'
AND b.BatchID = @LastBatchID
AND b.released = 1
